title: A force-stopped full-gate launcher left its rust-tests stage tree running on Windows
outcome: When a full-gate launcher is terminated from outside (forced exit), its running stage's whole process tree is ended, as docs/test.md promises ("A forced launcher exit ... closes the owner's private control channel, so its owner also shuts down the tree"), and recover does not settle a run while its stage processes are still alive.
acceptance: a regression terminates a full-gate launcher during a running stage on Windows and finds no surviving stage processes after the documented teardown budget
recover refuses or reports unresolved while processes of the run's stage remain
